rationale: Independently read revised source bodies: Kolkata municipal history states capital elevation in 1773 with subsequent nineteenth-century administrative chronology; municipal statistics introduction explicitly identifies British Raj capital lasting until 1911. Read NDMC transition history previously: decision moved capital from Calcutta to Delhi in 1911. Joint evidence now supports bounded 1859–1910 Calcutta central seat; original NDMC single-event extrapolation concern resolved through additional historical bodies. Seasonal Simla seat and geographic-control limitations retained; no modern urban statistics imported. Existing capital gaps only, no catalogue URL duplication.
